description: Name and save this account's search. Saving does not buy a subscription or start updates. Use the current revision and a stable retry key.

expected_revision.description: Latest workflow revision returned for this search. Stale values are rejected.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact request. Reuse it with identical arguments after an uncertain result; use a new key for changed arguments.

name.description: User-chosen name for this retained search. Naming it does not purchase or activate updates.

workflow_id.description: Exact account-owned workflow_id returned by the saved-search tools.

name: gisdb_save_search
